svg.title: Fixed supply. Funded payouts. Real exposure.
svg.desc: The current OMR contract initially mints 100 million tokens to the treasury Safe. Funded inventory supplies payouts without reward minting. Deed supply is 2,500 permanent identities: 1,000 gameplay-earned, 1,000 paid and 500 partnership. Burning or trading does not replenish primary supply. Gameplay death can take 50 percent of loose or unbonding OMR and 20 percent of staked OMR; unbonding lasts six hours. Separate ETH staking uses 30-day per-deposit locks and variable funded ETH rewards. No fixed APY is promised. Implementation snapshot 30 OCT 2026. Prelaunch: deployment and activation are not verified by this diagram. Sources: omerta-contracts/src/market-v2/OmertaRestrictedOMRV2.sol:24; omerta-contracts/src/StreetDeed.sol:49; omerta-contracts/src/market-v2/OmertaEthStakingV2.sol:21; docs/WIKI.md:240.
svg.text: Fixed supply. Funded payouts. Real exposure.
Funded rewards move assets. They do not mint new OMR.

g.text: Inventory funds OMR payouts. ETH and stocks need backing. No fixed APY.

svg.text: Implementation snapshot. Deployment, funding and launch activation are separate checks.
